statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ has produced a meaningful cash-open rebound from the session low, while oil and still-high Treasury yields keep the broader environment stressed.
recommendation: Tail has de-escalated as mean reversion reappeared. The remaining WATCH state reflects the still-fragile post-open window and elevated cross-asset stress rather than an observed no-retracement path.
headline: Meaningful NQ mean reversion cuts Tail to WATCH while oil and rates keep Stress extreme.
body: At cutoff, delayed NQ was about 30,569, roughly 199 points above the 30,370 session low and near the middle-upper part of the 30,370-30,713.5 range. The 30-minute signal was Buy and hourly Neutral. The U.S. 10-year was near 5.092, Brent near 105.49 and VIX near 15.72. Shared Finviz context was older than 90 minutes and excluded from current scoring.

lookbackSummary: Published ChatGPT history shows Tail rising from low/watch overnight to high before the U.S. cash open. The 13:00 UTC assessment remained high at 46% before the subsequent rebound.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is back in WATCH because NQ recovered materially from the session low and short-horizon structure improved. Stress remains extreme; renewed one-way extension with failed retracements would be the condition for re-escalation. The next major scheduled checkpoint is Durable Goods at 12:30 UTC on September 25.

forecast.analysis: Observed NQ near 30,569 has rebounded about 199 points from the 30,370 session low into the middle-upper part of the range. The 30-minute signal turned Buy and hourly Neutral, showing meaningful mean reversion despite still-elevated macro stress.
drivers: NQ rebounded about 199 points from the 30,370 session low
30-minute Buy and hourly Neutral after the earlier selloff
U.S. 10-year near 5.092, lower on the session

forecast.analysis: The 15:00 UTC slot remains a post-open digestion window around the scheduled 14:00 UTC housing-release window. Tail stays in WATCH only if the rebound remains two-way; renewed failure of retracements and a return toward session lows would raise path risk.
drivers: Post-open digestion around the scheduled 14:00 UTC housing-release window
Rebound depth versus renewed session-low pressure

forecast.analysis: By 16:00 UTC, WATCH risk assumes the morning recovery continues to produce meaningful counter-moves. A fresh one-way leg with failed rebounds would invalidate that normalization.
At 17:00 UTC, Tail remains in WATCH conditionally if price rotates through a broader range. Repeated extension without retracement would be the main reason for a higher state.
drivers: Depth of pullbacks after any new extension

forecast.analysis: At 18:00 UTC, low Tail assumes the cash session develops balanced swings rather than another directional cascade. Stress remains elevated because oil and rates can still amplify a renewed move.
At 19:00 UTC, low Tail assumes mean reversion remains functional into the afternoon. A break from the range with shallow counter-moves would be the key adverse conditional path.
At 20:00 UTC, low Tail assumes no renewed directional acceleration into the late session. Stress remains high enough that a fresh catalyst could still widen moves.
At 21:00 UTC, low Tail assumes the U.S. close does not preserve a one-way impulse. A balanced finish would further weaken the pathological path case.
At 22:00 UTC, low Tail assumes post-close price discovery remains orderly. Thin-liquidity extension without retracement would be the main conditional risk.
At 23:00 UTC, low Tail assumes no new geopolitical or rates shock interrupts the post-close normalization. Overnight liquidity keeps Stress elevated relative to Tail.
At 00:00 UTC, low Tail assumes Asia opens without a fresh directional gap and that counter-moves remain available. Stress continues to reflect headline and cross-asset uncertainty.
At 01:00 UTC, low Tail assumes early Asian trading remains two-way. A persistent gap extension with weak retracements would be the main invalidation.
At 02:00 UTC, low Tail assumes overnight volatility stays contained. Any fresh geopolitical discontinuity would raise Stress first unless NQ also develops persistent one-way structure.
drivers: NQ structure remains the Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: At 03:00 UTC, low Tail assumes the Asian session does not transition into a persistent directional trend. Cross-asset confirmation would matter only if NQ also loses mean reversion.
At 04:00 UTC, low Tail assumes Europe approaches without a fresh gap or repeated extension. Oil and rates remain the main external amplifiers to reassess.
At 05:00 UTC, low Tail assumes European liquidity broadens two-way trading. A synchronized risk-off move would increase Stress before Tail unless NQ retracements also fail.
At 06:00 UTC, low Tail assumes Europe does not reinforce a one-way Nasdaq path. Persistent extension across index futures and rates would be the adverse checkpoint.
At 07:00 UTC, low Tail assumes any European trend remains retraceable. Stress stays extreme because the next U.S. data window is drawing closer.
At 08:00 UTC, WATCH Tail reflects the transition toward U.S. premarket liquidity. It remains conditional on whether overnight moves retain meaningful pullbacks.
At 09:00 UTC, WATCH Tail assumes premarket structure is still two-way. A persistent premarket extension with failed retracements would justify a higher path-risk state.
At 10:00 UTC, WATCH Tail reflects rising event proximity rather than an assumed future trend. Actual NQ structure remains the condition for any escalation.
drivers: Event proximity raises Stress, not automatic Tail

forecast.analysis: At 11:00 UTC, WATCH Tail reflects the approach to the 12:30 UTC Durable Goods release. No directional outcome is assumed; realized retracement quality would determine escalation.
drivers: Retracement quality after any pre-event move

forecast.analysis: At 12:00 UTC, WATCH Tail reflects the 12:30 UTC Durable Goods checkpoint. Event importance lifts Stress, while Tail remains below blocking levels absent observed persistent extension.
drivers: Observed post-release path remains the Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: At 13:00 UTC, elevated Tail is conditional on the Durable Goods reaction producing repeated extension, shallow pullbacks, or session-extreme holding. Orderly two-way discovery would keep Tail lower.

forecastDetail.comment: Current-hour evidence shows a substantial rebound from the session low and short-horizon technical repair, so Tail has de-escalated to WATCH while macro Stress remains extreme.
Post-open digestion remains the main checkpoint; WATCH persists if two-way trade continues, while failed retracements would raise Tail.
Normalization continues conditionally if meaningful counter-moves persist and the opening range is not abandoned in one direction.
Mid-session WATCH risk depends on whether range rotation survives; repeated extension without pullbacks would invalidate it.
Low Tail assumes balanced swings and volatility decay, with oil and rates remaining external Stress amplifiers.
Low Tail assumes afternoon mean reversion remains available; a new range break with shallow counter-moves is the main adverse path.
